description:
## Goal

Integrate Git Control Tower's standardized review into ecosystem-manager's agent loop so every iteration produces a health snapshot of the target scenario.

## Implementation

### API Integration
- Add a review client in ecosystem-manager (similar to `scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/execution/review_client.go`)
- After each loop iteration completes, call `POST /api/v1/review/run` with the target scenario name
- Poll `GET /api/v1/review/run/{jobId}` until completion
- Store the ReviewResult (classification + 5 dimensions) in the execution history

### Per-Loop Snapshot Storage
- Enrich ExecutionHistory records with ReviewResult data
- Store dimension statuses (codeQuality, tests, standards, visual, provenance) per iteration
- Compute and store deltas between consecutive iterations

### Regression Detection
- Compare current iteration's review to previous iteration
- Flag regressions: dimension status going from green → yellow or yellow → red
- Surface regressions in the task detail UI and execution history

### Configuration
- Configurable review trigger: every iteration, only successful iterations, or manual
- Configurable check selection (which Git Control Tower dimensions to run)
- Option to block next iteration until review completes

## Key References

- Swarm-manager review integration: `scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/execution/service.go` (lines 605-646, 689-703)
- Git Control Tower API: `scenarios/git-control-tower/api/review_handler.go`
- Ecosystem-manager execution: `scenarios/ecosystem-manager/api/pkg/queue/execution_manager.go`
- Execution history: `scenarios/ecosystem-manager/api/pkg/queue/execution_history.go`
